mapper.sql: p.price_id, p.tenant_id, p.material_id, m.material_code, m.material_name, p.customer_id, c.customer_code, c.customer_name, p.trade_type, p.unit_price, p.currency, p.start_dt, p.end_dt, p.moq, p.use_at, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.updated_by, p.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_item_partner_price p LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = p.material_id AND m.tenant_id = p.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id AND c.tenant_id = p.tenant_id WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.price_id = #{priceId}

SELECT material_id AS "materialId", material_code AS "materialCode", material_name AS "materialName" FROM tb_material_info WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND material_id = #{materialId} AND delete_status = 'N' AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT customer_id AS "customerId", customer_code AS "customerCode", customer_name AS "customerName" FROM tb_customer_info WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer_id = #{customerId} AND use_at = 'Y'

INSERT INTO tb_item_partner_price ( tenant_id, material_id, customer_id, trade_type, unit_price, currency, start_dt, end_dt, moq, use_at, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{materialId}, #{customerId}, #{tradeType}, #{unitPrice}, #{currency}, CAST(#{startDt} AS DATE), CAST(#{endDt} AS DATE), #{moq}, #{useAt}, #{createdBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updatedBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) RETURNING price_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_item_partner_price SET material_id = #{materialId}, customer_id = #{customerId}, trade_type = #{tradeType}, unit_price = #{unitPrice}, currency = #{currency}, start_dt = CAST(#{startDt} AS DATE), end_dt = CAST(#{endDt} AS DATE), moq = #{moq}, use_at = #{useAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND price_id = #{priceId}
